Sabal Trust Co decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 4.69% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 122,619 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $20.75 million, down from 128,654 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sabal Trust Co who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $895.92 billion market cap company.
